Class PluginsApi

java.lang.Object
com.erudika.para.server.rest.PluginsApi
@RestController @RequestMapping(value="/v1/_plugins", produces="application/json") public final class PluginsApi extends Object
REST endpoints for inspecting and installing Para plugins.

Plugins are thin JARs published to Maven Central, each carrying a manifest of its runtime dependencies. This controller lets an admin UI list what is available, preview what an install would fetch, install it, and remove it.

A restart is required after installing or removing a plugin, because the plugin classloader is built once during startup and cached. Selecting a different plugin via configuration also requires a restart, matching the requires restart tag on those config properties.

Author:
Alex Bogdanovski [alex@erudika.com]

    • preview

      @GetMapping("/{artifactId}/preview") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> preview(@PathVariable String artifactId)
      Reports what installing a plugin would download, without touching the plugin folder.

      Resolution happens in a temporary directory that is deleted afterwards, so an admin UI can show real numbers behind a confirmation prompt.

      Parameters:
      artifactId - the Maven artifactId of the plugin
      Returns:
      the plugin's declared dependencies and the total download size

    • install

      @PostMapping("/{artifactId}/install") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> install(@PathVariable String artifactId, @RequestBody(required=false) Map<String,Object> request)
      Downloads a plugin and all of its dependencies into the plugin folder.

      Every artifact is checksum-verified before it is written. Para must be restarted before the plugin can be loaded.

      Parameters:
      artifactId - the Maven artifactId of the plugin
      request - optional JSON body with a version field
      Returns:
      a summary of the installation

    • uninstall

      @DeleteMapping("/{artifactId}/{version}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> uninstall(@PathVariable String artifactId, @PathVariable String version)
      Removes a plugin JAR from the plugin folder.

      Only the plugin JAR is deleted. Its dependencies stay, because plugins routinely share them and a dependency JAR carries no record of which plugin wanted it.

      Parameters:
      artifactId - the Maven artifactId of the plugin
      version - the installed version
      Returns:
      an empty body on success
